chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever breaks a fast of Ramadan for a valid excuse, if he makes it up consecutively, that is superior; and if he makes it up separately, it is good."
ai.seo_question: Is it better to make up missed Ramadan fasts consecutively or individually?
ai.summary: In the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) distinguishing between the validity and the merit of making up Ramadan fasts. While scattered makeup fasting is legally sufficient (*hasan*), consecutive fasting is deemed superior (*afdal*), reflecting the Shia juristic preference for maintaining the spiritual continuity of the month's obligations. This ruling underscores the importance of both legal compliance and spiritual excellence in post-Ramadan observances.
